faq.a_en: General thinking, drafting, and quick research. It is the strongest all-round assistant we tested for daily productivity.
faq.a_zh: 通用思考、写作草稿和快速研究。是我们实测中最全能的日常助手。

faq.q_en: How does ChatGPT compare with Claude?
faq.q_zh: ChatGPT 和 Claude 有什么区别？
faq.a_en: ChatGPT is more well-rounded with voice, image and plugins; Claude produces more natural long-form writing and handles longer documents.
faq.a_zh: ChatGPT 更全能（语音、图像、插件），Claude 长文写作更自然、长文档能力更强。

faq.a_zh: 有。OpenAI 通过按量计费的 OpenAI API 提供 GPT 模型。

pricingSummary.en: Free tier with limits · Pro $20/mo unlocks larger context and Artifacts.
pricingSummary.zh: 免费版有额度限制；Pro 20 美元/月解锁更大上下文和 Artifacts。

faq.q_en: What context length does Claude support?
faq.a_en: Claude Pro supports a 200K-token context window, enough for a 100+ page document in one prompt.
faq.a_zh: Claude Pro 支持 200K token 上下文，可一次处理 100 页以上文档。

faq.q_en: Is Claude better than ChatGPT for writing?
faq.q_zh: Claude 写作比 ChatGPT 更好吗？
faq.a_en: For long-form English writing with a natural voice, Claude is our top pick.
faq.a_zh: 在自然风格的长文英文写作上，Claude 是我们的首选。

faq.q_en: Does Claude connect to the web?
faq.a_en: Native web browsing is limited today; use Perplexity or Gemini when live search is critical.
faq.a_zh: 原生联网较弱；需要实时联网请选 Perplexity 或 Gemini。

faq.a_en: Availability varies by region. Anthropic publishes an up-to-date list of supported countries.
faq.a_zh: 可用地区因国家而异，请以 Anthropic 官方列表为准。

pricingSummary.en: Generous free tier · Gemini Advanced $20/mo unlocks 2M context and Gemini Live.
pricingSummary.zh: 免费额度较慷慨；Gemini Advanced 20 美元/月解锁 2M 上下文和 Gemini Live。

faq.q_en: What can Gemini do that ChatGPT cannot?
faq.a_en: Native video understanding, a 2-million-token context window, and deep Google Search integration.
faq.a_zh: 原生视频理解、200 万 token 上下文和最深的 Google 搜索集成。

faq.a_en: Yes. Gemini Live offers real-time voice conversations with natural intonation.
faq.a_zh: 支持。Gemini Live 提供自然语音对话。

faq.a_en: Base Gemini is free. Gemini Advanced costs $20/month for higher limits and features.
faq.a_zh: 基础版免费；Advanced 20 美元/月解锁更高额度和功能。

pricingSummary.en: Free for verified students · Individual $10/mo · Business $19/mo.
pricingSummary.zh: 学生免费；个人版 10 美元/月，团队版 19 美元/月。

faq.a_en: Free for verified students, open-source maintainers, and teachers. Others start at $10/month.
faq.a_zh: 学生、开源维护者和教师免费；其他用户 10 美元/月起。

faq.q_zh: Copilot 支持多文件编辑吗？
faq.a_en: Copilot Chat handles some multi-file edits; for repo-wide agent work Cursor is more capable.
faq.a_zh: Copilot Chat 支持部分多文件编辑；仓库级 Agent 场景 Cursor 更强。

faq.a_en: 30+ languages including Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java and C#.
faq.a_zh: 30+ 语言，涵盖 Python、JavaScript/TypeScript、Go、Rust、Java、C# 等。

pricingSummary.en: Hobby tier is free · Pro $20/mo unlocks larger models and Agent mode.
pricingSummary.zh: 免费版可用；Pro 20 美元/月解锁大模型与 Agent 模式。

faq.q_en: How is Cursor different from VS Code?
faq.q_zh: Cursor 与 VS Code 有什么不同？
faq.a_en: Cursor is a VS Code fork with GPT-4-level AI, codebase chat, and multi-file agent mode built in.
faq.a_zh: Cursor 是 VS Code 分支，内置 GPT-4 级 AI、代码库对话和多文件 Agent 模式。

faq.a_en: For full-time developers refactoring code daily, it usually pays back within the first week.
faq.a_zh: 对每天重构代码的全职开发者，通常一周内就能回本。

faq.q_en: Can Cursor read my entire codebase?
faq.q_zh: Cursor 可以阅读整个代码库吗？
faq.a_en: Yes. It indexes your project and lets you chat with the full codebase context.
faq.a_zh: 可以。Cursor 会索引项目并允许你基于整仓上下文对话。

pricingSummary.en: Basic $10/mo · Standard $30/mo · Pro $60/mo · Mega $120/mo.
pricingSummary.zh: 基础版 10 美元/月；标准 30；Pro 60；Mega 120 美元/月。

faq.q_en: Does Midjourney offer a free tier?
faq.a_en: No. Paid subscriptions start at $10/month.
faq.a_zh: 没有免费额度，10 美元/月起。

faq.a_en: The web app and the Discord bot both work; the web app is the recommended default in 2026.
faq.a_zh: 支持网页版和 Discord；2026 年推荐使用网页版。

faq.a_en: Standard and higher plans grant commercial usage rights.
faq.a_zh: 标准版及以上支持商用。

pricingSummary.en: Open source and free to self-host · Cloud hosts charge per generation.
pricingSummary.zh: 开源可自部署；云服务按次收费。

faq.q_en: Do I need a GPU for Stable Diffusion?
faq.q_zh: Stable Diffusion 需要 GPU 吗？
faq.a_en: Yes for local runs; cloud hosts (RunDiffusion, ThinkDiffusion) work without local hardware.
faq.a_zh: 本地运行需要 GPU；也可用 RunDiffusion、ThinkDiffusion 等云服务。

faq.q_en: How does SD compare with Midjourney?
faq.q_zh: SD 和 Midjourney 有什么区别？
faq.a_en: SD offers more control (LoRA, ControlNet, ComfyUI) but a steeper learning curve; Midjourney is easier for stylish output.
faq.a_zh: SD 可控性更强（LoRA、ControlNet、ComfyUI），学习曲线陡；Midjourney 更适合快速出美感。

faq.a_en: Yes, subject to the Stability AI community license.
faq.a_zh: 允许，须遵守 Stability AI 社区许可证。

pricingSummary.en: Free daily credits · Apprentice $12/mo · Artisan $30/mo · Maestro $60/mo.
pricingSummary.zh: 每日免费额度；Apprentice 12；Artisan 30；Maestro 60 美元/月。

faq.a_en: Game art, character design and concept art; Alchemy mode keeps style consistency across generations.
faq.a_zh: 游戏美术、角色设计和概念图；Alchemy 模式保持风格一致。

faq.a_en: Yes, with daily credits refreshed automatically.
faq.a_zh: 有，每天自动刷新额度。

pricingSummary.en: ChatGPT Plus $20/mo includes limited access · Pro tiers scale to $200/mo.
pricingSummary.zh: 包含在 ChatGPT Plus（20 美元/月）中限量访问；Pro 版最高 200 美元/月。

faq.a_en: Availability depends on region and OpenAI’s rollout; check the official announcement.
faq.a_zh: 可用性受地区和 OpenAI 推出节奏影响，请以官方公告为准。

faq.q_en: What clip length does Sora support?
faq.a_en: Up to 20 seconds per clip with strong character/physics consistency.
faq.a_zh: 最长 20 秒/段，角色与物理一致性表现出色。

pricingSummary.en: Free tier with limited credits · Standard $15/mo · Pro $35/mo · Unlimited $95/mo.
pricingSummary.zh: 免费额度有限；标准 15；Pro 35；Unlimited 95 美元/月。

faq.q_en: Which Runway plan should I pick?
faq.a_en: The $35/month Pro plan is the sweet spot for creators shipping regular content.
faq.a_zh: 常规创作者建议选 35 美元/月的 Pro 版。

faq.a_en: Yes — motion brush, inpainting, storyboard, and Gen-3 upscale ship in the app.
faq.a_zh: 内置运动笔刷、图像补全、故事板和 Gen-3 放大。

pricingSummary.en: Starter $5/mo · Creator $22/mo · Pro $99/mo · Scale $330/mo.
pricingSummary.zh: Starter 5；Creator 22；Pro 99；Scale 330 美元/月。

faq.q_zh: ElevenLabs 能克隆我的声音吗？
faq.a_en: Yes. Instant voice cloning requires only a short reference sample; professional cloning improves quality.
faq.a_zh: 支持。即时克隆只需少量样本；专业克隆效果更佳。

faq.a_en: 29 languages with natural intonation, including Chinese.
faq.a_zh: 29 种语言（含中文）语音自然。

pricingSummary.en: Free daily credits · Pro $10/mo · Premier $30/mo.
pricingSummary.zh: 每日免费额度；Pro 10；Premier 30 美元/月。

faq.q_en: Can I use Suno tracks commercially?
faq.q_zh: Suno 生成的音乐可以商用吗？
faq.a_en: Paid plans grant commercial usage rights.
faq.a_zh: 付费版本支持商用。

faq.a_en: Yes. Chinese lyrics generate cleanly in Suno v4.
faq.a_zh: 支持。Suno v4 生成中文歌词效果良好。

pricingSummary.en: Free tier · Hobbyist $24/mo · Pro $33/mo.
pricingSummary.zh: 免费版；Hobbyist 24；Pro 33 美元/月。

faq.q_zh: 什么是转写驱动的剪辑？
faq.a_en: You edit the transcript and Descript trims the audio/video to match.
faq.a_zh: 编辑文字稿即可自动裁剪对应音视频。

faq.q_zh: Descript 能自动去掉口头禅吗？
faq.a_en: Yes. Filler word removal is built in and works on speech in real time.
faq.a_zh: 支持自动去除口头禅，实时生效。

pricingSummary.en: $10/user/month add-on to any Notion plan.
pricingSummary.zh: 作为 Notion 附加组件，10 美元/用户/月。

faq.q_en: Do I need Notion to use Notion AI?
faq.q_zh: 使用 Notion AI 必须先用 Notion 吗？
faq.a_en: Yes. Notion AI is an add-on inside the Notion workspace.
faq.a_zh: 是。Notion AI 是 Notion 工作区中的附加组件。

faq.a_en: For teams already using Notion for docs, yes — it summarizes and drafts inside your existing knowledge base.
faq.a_zh: 已经在用 Notion 写文档的团队值得开通，可直接在知识库内总结和起草。

pricingSummary.en: Free tier · Pro $20/mo unlocks unlimited Pro Search and file upload.
pricingSummary.zh: 免费版；Pro 20 美元/月解锁无限 Pro Search 和文件上传。

faq.q_en: Is Perplexity a search engine or a chatbot?
faq.a_en: Both. It answers like a chatbot but cites live sources for every claim.
faq.a_zh: 两者兼具：像聊天一样答复，同时逐条引用可查证的来源。

faq.q_zh: Perplexity 能取代 Google 吗？
faq.a_en: For research and product comparison it is often faster; for navigational search Google is still preferred.
faq.a_zh: 研究和产品对比更快；导航式搜索仍以 Google 为主。

pricingSummary.en: Creator $49/mo · Teams $125/mo · Business custom.
pricingSummary.zh: Creator 49；Teams 125；Business 定制。

faq.a_en: Marketing teams that need brand voice consistency across many writers.
faq.a_zh: 需要在多位作者间保持品牌语调的营销团队。

faq.q_en: Is Jasper worth it for individuals?
faq.q_zh: 个人使用 Jasper 值吗？
faq.a_en: For individuals, Claude Pro or ChatGPT Plus deliver similar output at lower cost.
faq.a_zh: 个人使用建议改用 Claude Pro 或 ChatGPT Plus，性价比更高。

pricingSummary.en: Premium $2.99/mo · Business $3.99/mo · Cloud $9.99/mo (introductory).
pricingSummary.zh: Premium 2.99；Business 3.99；Cloud 9.99 美元/月（首年优惠）。

faq.q_en: Is Hostinger suitable for high-traffic sites?
faq.a_en: Entry-level plans have shared resource caps; scale up to Cloud or use a CDN when traffic grows.
faq.a_zh: 低价套餐资源受限；高流量请升级 Cloud 或叠加 CDN。

faq.q_en: Does Hostinger include a free domain?
faq.a_en: Yes, annual Business+ plans include a free first-year domain and SSL.
faq.a_zh: 年付 Business 及以上版本赠首年域名和 SSL。

pricingSummary.en: Free web/app chat · API $0.14/M input, $0.28/M output for V3 · R1 reasoning at $0.55/M input, $2.19/M output · Weights open-source for self-hosting.
pricingSummary.zh: 网页/APP 免费使用；V3 API 输入 $0.14/M、输出 $0.28/M；R1 推理输入 $0.55/M、输出 $2.19/M；开源权重可自部署。

faq.a_en: Yes — the web app and mobile app are free. Paid usage only kicks in when you call the API or self-host on your own GPUs.
faq.a_zh: 网页版和 App 免费使用。只有调用 API 或自托管 GPU 部署时才产生费用。

faq.q_en: How is DeepSeek so much cheaper than GPT-5 or Claude?
faq.q_zh: DeepSeek 为什么比 GPT-5 和 Claude 便宜这么多？
faq.a_en: DeepSeek trained a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model that activates only ~37B of its 671B parameters per token, so inference cost is a fraction of dense frontier models. Public weights let cloud vendors compete on price.
faq.a_zh: DeepSeek 用 MoE 架构，每个 token 只激活 671B 中的约 37B 参数，推理成本大幅低于稠密前沿模型；开源权重让云厂商充分竞争，进一步压价。

faq.q_en: What is DeepSeek-R1 and how is it different from V3?
faq.q_zh: DeepSeek-R1 和 V3 有什么区别？
faq.a_en: V3 is the general-purpose chat/coding model. R1 is the reasoning model with visible chain-of-thought; use R1 for math, code review, planning and hard reasoning, use V3 for everything else.
faq.a_zh: V3 是通用对话/编程模型；R1 是推理模型，会输出显式思维链，适合数学、代码审查、复杂规划；日常任务用 V3 更划算。

faq.q_en: How does DeepSeek compare to ChatGPT for Chinese content?
faq.q_zh: 中文内容上 DeepSeek 和 ChatGPT 谁更强？
faq.a_en: DeepSeek's Chinese writing and reasoning are noticeably more natural than ChatGPT on native mainland-Chinese prompts. For English long-form writing, Claude still leads.
faq.a_zh: 在中国大陆语境的中文提示上，DeepSeek 的表达自然度和推理能力优于 ChatGPT；英文长文写作仍以 Claude 最佳。

faq.a_en: Yes. Full weights are released under an MIT-style license. Practical self-hosting requires 8×H100 or equivalent for the full V3/R1; distilled variants run on a single 24 GB GPU.
faq.a_zh: 可以，权重按 MIT 类协议开放。完整 V3/R1 需 8×H100 或等效算力；蒸馏版可在单卡 24 GB 上运行。

faq.q_en: Is DeepSeek safe for enterprise data?
faq.q_zh: 企业用 DeepSeek 数据安全吗？
faq.a_en: The hosted API stores prompts and may use them for service improvement unless you opt out. For sensitive data, deploy the open-source weights on your own infrastructure or use a private cloud (Azure, AWS, Volcano Engine) that offers DeepSeek without data retention.
faq.a_zh: 官方 API 默认会保留提示、用于改进服务，除非申请退出。敏感数据建议自部署开源权重，或选择 Azure、AWS、火山引擎等提供 DeepSeek 且不留存数据的私有云。

faq.q_en: How good is DeepSeek at coding?
faq.a_en: V3 is competitive with Claude 3.5 Sonnet on HumanEval and beats GPT-4o on many benchmarks. R1 excels at multi-file refactor reasoning. Cursor and Cline both support DeepSeek as the underlying model.
faq.a_zh: V3 在 HumanEval 上接近 Claude 3.5 Sonnet，多数基准优于 GPT-4o；R1 在多文件重构推理上表现出色。Cursor 与 Cline 均支持将 DeepSeek 作为底层模型。

faq.q_en: Does DeepSeek support image and voice input?
faq.q_zh: DeepSeek 支持图像和语音输入吗？
faq.a_en: V3 has limited multimodal support; DeepSeek-VL handles vision separately. For serious multimodal work, Gemini 2.5 Pro or GPT-5 remain stronger choices in 2026.
faq.a_zh: V3 多模态能力有限，DeepSeek-VL 单独处理视觉输入；2026 年需要重度多模态时仍建议 Gemini 2.5 Pro 或 GPT-5。

faq.q_en: Are there censorship or topic restrictions?
faq.q_zh: 有内容审查或话题限制吗？
faq.a_en: The hosted DeepSeek service filters politically sensitive Chinese topics. The open-source weights on your own hardware do not carry the same filter but still reflect training-data bias.
faq.a_zh: 官方托管服务对政治敏感中文话题存在过滤；自部署开源权重没有相同过滤层，但仍受训练数据影响。

faq.q_zh: 什么用户不适合用 DeepSeek？
faq.a_en: Teams needing tightly integrated voice, image and plugin ecosystems (ChatGPT Plus wins) or the most natural English long-form writing (Claude wins). For everyone else it is the best price/performance model in 2026.
faq.a_zh: 需要深度整合语音、图像和插件生态的团队（选 ChatGPT Plus）、追求最自然英文长文的团队（选 Claude）；其他场景 DeepSeek 是 2026 年性价比最高的选择。

pricingSummary.en: Free tier with generous prompt credits · Pro $15/mo (500 prompt credits) · Ultimate $60/mo (unlimited fast credits and premium models).
pricingSummary.zh: 免费版含较慷慨的调用额度；Pro 15 美元/月（500 次 prompt 额度）；Ultimate 60 美元/月（无限快速额度 + 高级模型）。

faq.a_en: Yes. The free tier ships Cascade agent and autocomplete with a monthly credit cap. Pro at $15/month unlocks 500 prompt credits and higher-tier models.
faq.a_zh: 免费版即可使用 Cascade Agent 与代码补全，每月有额度上限；Pro（15 美元/月）解锁 500 次 prompt 额度和更高等级模型。

faq.q_en: How does Windsurf compare to Cursor?
faq.q_zh: Windsurf 与 Cursor 有什么区别？
faq.a_en: Cursor emphasizes hand-guided edits and codebase chat; Windsurf's Cascade agent leans more autonomous, executes commands and iterates until tests pass. Windsurf's free tier is more generous; Cursor's plugin ecosystem is bigger.
faq.a_zh: Cursor 更偏手动引导的编辑与代码库对话；Windsurf 的 Cascade Agent 更自主，能执行命令并自动迭代到测试通过；Windsurf 免费额度更慷慨，Cursor 插件生态更大。

faq.a_en: Cascade is Windsurf's autonomous coding agent that reads the whole workspace, plans multi-step tasks, runs commands, edits multiple files and can retry until objectives are met — all inside the IDE.
faq.a_zh: Cascade 是 Windsurf 内置的自主编码 Agent，读取整个工作区、规划多步任务、执行命令并跨文件修改，可自动重试直到达成目标。

faq.q_en: Can Windsurf run against my own model?
faq.q_zh: Windsurf 可以接入自有模型吗？
faq.a_en: Yes. Team and Enterprise plans support custom endpoints for OpenAI-compatible APIs, Azure OpenAI, and self-hosted models via LiteLLM-style proxies.
faq.a_zh: 支持。Team 和 Enterprise 计划允许接入自定义端点，包括 OpenAI 兼容 API、Azure OpenAI，以及通过 LiteLLM 类代理接入自托管模型。

faq.q_en: Is Windsurf a VS Code fork?
faq.q_zh: Windsurf 是 VS Code 分支吗？
faq.a_en: Yes. It is built on the VS Code open-source base, so most VS Code extensions and keybindings work. Codeium plans a JetBrains variant on the same agent runtime.
faq.a_zh: 是。基于 VS Code 开源版构建，绝大多数 VS Code 插件和快捷键可直接使用；Codeium 计划推出 JetBrains 版本，共用同一 Agent 运行时。

faq.q_en: How good is Windsurf for large codebases?
faq.q_zh: Windsurf 处理大型代码库表现如何？
faq.a_en: Cascade indexes the workspace and maintains long-term context per branch. In our testing it handles repos up to a few hundred thousand lines cleanly; beyond that you should scope work with folder filters.
faq.a_zh: Cascade 会索引工作区并按分支维护长期上下文；实测数十万行仓库表现稳定，更大规模建议用文件夹过滤缩小范围。

faq.a_en: Autocomplete works with local models via Windsurf's on-device inference; agentic and chat features require a network connection to the Codeium or your enterprise endpoint.
faq.a_zh: 代码补全可通过本地模型离线运行；Agent 与对话功能仍需要网络连接到 Codeium 服务或企业自建端点。

faq.q_en: Is Windsurf safe for proprietary code?
faq.q_zh: Windsurf 用于自有代码安全吗？
faq.a_en: Enterprise plans include zero-data-retention agreements, on-prem deployment and audit logging. On the free/Pro plans, code snippets sent for inference follow Codeium's public data policy — review it before uploading trade secrets.
faq.a_zh: Enterprise 版提供零数据保留协议、私有化部署和审计日志；免费版和 Pro 版发送的代码片段遵循 Codeium 公开的数据政策，涉及商业机密前请先审阅条款。

faq.q_en: What language and framework support does Windsurf have?
faq.q_zh: Windsurf 支持哪些语言和框架？
faq.a_en: 70+ languages including Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Go, Rust, Java, C#, PHP, Kotlin and Swift. Cascade is stronger on TypeScript/Python/Go than niche languages like OCaml or Erlang.
faq.a_zh: 70+ 语言，包括 Python、TypeScript/JavaScript、Go、Rust、Java、C#、PHP、Kotlin、Swift；Cascade 在 TS/Python/Go 上表现最好，OCaml/Erlang 等冷门语言相对弱。

faq.q_en: Is Windsurf worth switching from Cursor or Copilot?
faq.q_zh: Cursor 或 Copilot 用户值得切到 Windsurf 吗？
faq.a_en: Try it side-by-side for a week. Windsurf wins if you rely on autonomous multi-step agent runs and want a generous free tier; Cursor wins if you prefer manual precision and richer plugins; Copilot wins if you never want to leave your existing IDE.
faq.a_zh: 先并行试用一周：偏好自主多步 Agent + 慷慨免费额度选 Windsurf；偏好手动精度和更丰富插件选 Cursor；不想换编辑器选 Copilot。

pricingSummary.en: Extension itself is free and open-source; you pay only for the model API you choose (Claude Sonnet 4/OpenRouter/DeepSeek/local via Ollama). Typical Sonnet 4 spend: $5–40/mo per developer.
pricingSummary.zh: 扩展本身开源免费；只按你选用的模型 API 付费（Claude Sonnet 4/OpenRouter/DeepSeek/本地 Ollama 等）。使用 Sonnet 4 时开发者每月典型花费 5–40 美元。

faq.a_en: A free, open-source VS Code extension that turns any LLM into an autonomous coding agent — it reads your workspace, proposes edits, runs terminal commands and pauses for your approval at each risky step.
faq.a_zh: 一个免费、开源的 VS Code 扩展，将任意 LLM 转化为自主编码 Agent —— 读取工作区、提出修改、执行终端命令，并在关键步骤等待你审批。

faq.q_en: Does Cline require paying for a model?
faq.q_zh: 使用 Cline 必须为模型付费吗？
faq.a_en: Yes for hosted models. You bring your own API key (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, DeepSeek, OpenRouter). It also supports local models via Ollama or LM Studio for zero-cost inference.
faq.a_zh: 调用托管模型需付费。你需要自备 API Key（Anthropic、OpenAI、Google、DeepSeek、OpenRouter 等）；也支持通过 Ollama 或 LM Studio 使用本地模型免费推理。

faq.q_en: How does Cline compare to Cursor and Windsurf?
faq.q_zh: Cline 与 Cursor、Windsurf 有什么区别？
faq.a_en: Cursor and Windsurf are polished commercial IDE forks with bundled models; Cline is a free extension you drop into your existing editor with a model of your choice. Cline is cheaper and more transparent; Cursor/Windsurf have smoother multi-file editing UX.
faq.a_zh: Cursor 与 Windsurf 是打包模型的商业化 IDE 分支，体验更精致；Cline 是免费扩展，插入现有编辑器并自选模型，成本更低、更透明；跨文件编辑的 UX 略逊于前两者。

faq.q_en: Is Cline safe to run against my repo?
faq.q_zh: Cline 直接跑我的仓库安全吗？
faq.a_en: Cline pauses before every terminal command and file write and asks for approval. Enable auto-approval only for scoped read-only or test commands. Never point it at production credentials.
faq.a_zh: Cline 在执行每条终端命令和写文件前都会暂停请求批准；仅对只读或测试命令启用自动批准；生产凭据绝不放在其可访问的环境。

faq.q_en: What models work best in Cline?
faq.q_zh: 在 Cline 中哪种模型效果最好？
faq.a_en: Claude Sonnet 4 remains the default for planning and multi-file edits. DeepSeek-V3 is the cheapest workable option. Local Qwen2.5-Coder or Llama-3.1-70B work for offline use if you have enough VRAM.
faq.a_zh: 规划与跨文件编辑首选 Claude Sonnet 4；DeepSeek-V3 是最便宜的可用选项；显存充足时可离线使用本地 Qwen2.5-Coder 或 Llama-3.1-70B。

faq.q_en: Can Cline read my whole codebase?
faq.q_zh: Cline 可以读取整个代码库吗？
faq.a_en: It selectively reads files based on task context rather than indexing the whole repo. Provide focus paths in the prompt or use its file-tree view to guide attention on large monorepos.
faq.a_zh: Cline 根据任务上下文有选择地读取文件，而非全库索引；大 monorepo 请在提示中指定关注目录，或用其文件树视图引导。

faq.a_en: Cline officially targets VS Code, Cursor and Windsurf (all VS Code forks). The community Roo Code fork exposes similar capability to JetBrains and Zed via a bridge.
faq.a_zh: Cline 官方支持 VS Code、Cursor 和 Windsurf（都是 VS Code 分支）；社区 Roo Code 分支通过桥接让 JetBrains 和 Zed 用户也能获得类似能力。

faq.q_en: Is the token bill really high?
faq.a_en: Autonomous agents re-read files and re-plan each iteration, so token spend is 3–10× a single-shot completion. Use DeepSeek or prompt caching in Anthropic to keep monthly cost under $40 for individual use.
faq.a_zh: 自主 Agent 每一轮都会重读文件、重新规划，Token 消耗是单次补全的 3–10 倍；改用 DeepSeek 或 Anthropic prompt cache 可将个人月度成本控制在 40 美元内。

faq.a_en: Developers who want autonomous agents but refuse to switch editors or lock into a bundled model, plus teams that need transparent, auditable open-source tooling for compliance.
faq.a_zh: 想用自主 Agent 但不愿换编辑器、也不想被单一模型绑定的开发者；以及需要透明可审计开源工具满足合规要求的团队。

faq.q_en: How is Cline different from Aider?
faq.q_zh: Cline 与 Aider 有何不同？
faq.a_en: Aider is a terminal-first pair-programming tool with tight Git integration. Cline lives inside VS Code and can drive the terminal too but keeps the diff/preview UI. Aider is minimalist; Cline is more agentic and visual.
faq.a_zh: Aider 以终端为中心，深度整合 Git，更精简；Cline 驻留在 VS Code 内并可控制终端，同时保留 diff 与预览界面，交互更 Agent 化、更可视化。

pricingSummary.en: Individual completion + chat: free forever · Teams $12/seat/mo (SSO + shared context) · Enterprise custom (self-hosted, air-gapped).
pricingSummary.zh: 个人版补全 + 聊天永久免费；Teams 12 美元/席/月（含 SSO 与共享上下文）；Enterprise 支持自部署与内网隔离，价格定制。

faq.a_en: Yes for individuals. Unlimited code completion and chat with no credit card. Team collaboration, SSO, and shared context libraries move to the $12/seat/month plan.
faq.a_zh: 对个人用户完全免费——无限量代码补全与聊天，无需信用卡；团队协作、SSO 与共享上下文库需 12 美元/席/月的 Team 版。

faq.q_en: How does Codeium make money if it is free?
faq.a_en: Enterprise deals: self-hosted deployments for banks, defense, healthcare and other regulated industries. The Windsurf IDE also monetizes power users on top of the same Codeium core.
faq.a_zh: 主要靠企业业务：为金融、国防、医疗等受监管行业提供自部署服务；同一 Codeium 内核之上还有 Windsurf IDE 面向重度用户变现。

faq.q_en: How does Codeium compare with GitHub Copilot?
faq.q_zh: Codeium 与 GitHub Copilot 相比如何？
faq.a_en: Autocomplete quality is close in 2026. Codeium wins on price (free vs $10/month), language breadth and IDE coverage (10+ IDEs). Copilot has richer chat and multi-file features and deeper GitHub integration.
faq.a_zh: 2026 年补全质量已接近；Codeium 胜在价格（免费 vs 10 美元/月）、语言广度和 IDE 覆盖（10+ IDE）；Copilot 拥有更丰富的聊天、多文件功能和更深的 GitHub 集成。

faq.q_en: Does Codeium train on my code?
faq.q_zh: Codeium 会用我的代码训练模型吗？
faq.a_en: By default no — telemetry only. Enterprise plans add contractual zero-data-retention and on-prem deployment for teams that cannot send code to the public cloud.
faq.a_zh: 默认不使用你的代码训练，仅收集遥测数据；Enterprise 版通过合同承诺零数据保留，并支持内网自部署。

faq.a_en: VS Code, JetBrains suite, Neovim, Vim, Emacs, Sublime, Xcode, Android Studio, Eclipse and Chrome DevTools. Codeium's Windsurf editor is a full VS Code fork built on the same engine.
faq.a_zh: VS Code、JetBrains 全家桶、Neovim、Vim、Emacs、Sublime、Xcode、Android Studio、Eclipse 与 Chrome DevTools；Codeium 同源打造的 Windsurf 是完整的 VS Code 分支。

faq.q_en: Can Codeium do multi-file refactor like Cursor?
faq.q_zh: Codeium 能像 Cursor 一样跨文件重构吗？
faq.a_en: The free extension focuses on completion + single-file chat. For repo-wide agentic edits, upgrade to Codeium's Windsurf IDE, which unlocks Cascade multi-file agent runs.
faq.a_zh: 免费扩展主打补全与单文件对话；如需仓库级 Agent 编辑，可升级到 Codeium 同源的 Windsurf IDE，解锁 Cascade 多文件 Agent。

faq.q_en: How many languages does Codeium support?
faq.a_en: Officially 70+, including Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Go, Rust, Java, C#, C/C++, Kotlin, Swift, PHP, Ruby, Elixir, Lua, and shell dialects. Quality is highest on the top 20 languages.
faq.a_zh: 官方 70+，涵盖 Python、TypeScript/JavaScript、Go、Rust、Java、C#、C/C++、Kotlin、Swift、PHP、Ruby、Elixir、Lua 以及各类 Shell；Top 20 语言质量最佳。

faq.a_en: Yes — the free tier is one of the best deals in AI coding right now. No credit card, unlimited completion, works in VS Code and JetBrains which most CS courses already use.
faq.a_zh: 非常适合——免费版是当前 AI 编程最具性价比的选择之一，无需信用卡、无限补全、覆盖大多数计算机课程使用的 VS Code 与 JetBrains。

faq.a_en: Individual plans require the cloud service. Enterprise plans offer on-prem servers so the entire completion pipeline can run inside your VPC or fully air-gapped network.
faq.a_zh: 个人版依赖云服务；Enterprise 版支持将整个补全服务部署到你的 VPC 或完全离线网络中。

faq.q_en: Is Codeium the same as Windsurf?
faq.q_zh: Codeium 和 Windsurf 是同一个产品吗？
faq.a_en: Same company, different products. Codeium is the free IDE extension focused on completion and chat. Windsurf is the paid AI-native IDE with agentic Cascade workflows built on top of Codeium's engine.
faq.a_zh: 同一公司，不同产品：Codeium 是免费的 IDE 扩展，专注补全与对话；Windsurf 是付费的 AI 原生 IDE，在 Codeium 引擎之上叠加 Cascade Agent 工作流。

pricingSummary.en: Entirely free: text, image, and video generation via a single API. No credit card required. Open-source client SDKs available on GitHub.
pricingSummary.zh: 完全免费：通过单一 API 调用文本、图像和视频生成。无需信用卡。开源 SDK 可在 GitHub 上获取。

faq.a_en: Yes. The entire API platform is free to use — no credit card, no usage limits for the core modalities. The project is open-source and community-driven.
faq.a_zh: 完全免费——无需信用卡，核心功能没有使用限制。项目开源且由社区驱动。

faq.q_en: What modalities does Agnes AI support?
faq.q_zh: Agnes AI 支持什么模型？
faq.a_en: Text generation, image generation, and video generation — all through a single API endpoint. Additional models are added regularly.
faq.a_zh: 文本生成、图像生成和视频生成——全部通过单一 API 端点。新模型持续添加中。

faq.q_en: How good is Agnes AI compared to GPT-5 or Claude?
faq.q_zh: Agnes AI 与 GPT-5 或 Claude 相比如何？
faq.a_en: The individual models do not yet match the quality of frontier models like GPT-5 or Claude Sonnet for complex tasks. The value is in the free omni-modal access, not the ceiling quality.
faq.a_zh: 单个模型在复杂任务上尚不及 GPT-5 或 Claude Sonnet 等前沿模型。其价值在于免费的任意模态访问，而非天花板质量。

faq.q_en: Is Agnes AI suitable for production use?
faq.q_zh: Agnes AI 适合生产环境吗？
faq.a_en: The API is stable and the open-source SDKs are well-documented, but uptime is not guaranteed by a commercial SLA. Best suited for prototyping, side projects, and learning.
faq.a_zh: API 稳定、开源 SDK 文档完善，但无商业 SLA 保障。最适合原型开发、个人项目和学习的场景。

faq.q_en: Does Agnes AI have an API key?
faq.q_zh: Agnes AI 需要 API Key 吗？
faq.a_en: Yes. Register on the website for a free API key. The key works across all text, image, and video endpoints with no separate billing.
faq.a_zh: 在官网注册即可获得免费 API Key，一套 Key 适用于所有文本、图像和视频端点，无需单独计费。

faq.q_en: What is the image quality like?
faq.a_en: Comparable to Midjourney v5 for general prompts. Lags behind Midjourney v7, Flux, and Ideogram for fine details, text rendering, and photorealism.
faq.a_zh: 通用提示词下接近 Midjourney v5 水平；细节、文字渲染和照片级写实上落后于 Midjourney v7、Flux 和 Ideogram。

faq.a_en: The client SDKs and some model infrastructure are open-source on GitHub. The core API server is proprietary but freely accessible.
faq.a_zh: 客户端 SDK 和部分模型基础设施在 GitHub 开源；核心 API 服务器闭源但可免费使用。

faq.q_en: Can I use Agnes AI for commercial projects?
faq.a_en: Yes, the free tier permits commercial use. Check the latest license on GitHub for any restrictions on derivative models or redistribution.
faq.a_zh: 免费版允许商用。具体限制请查阅 GitHub 上的最新许可证——特别是关于衍生模型和再分发部分。

faq.q_en: What is the best alternative to Agnes AI?
faq.q_zh: Agnes AI 的最佳替代品是什么？
faq.a_en: If you need higher quality at low cost: DeepSeek (text) + Flux (images) + Kling (video). If you need a single paid provider: OpenAI GPT-5 with its built-in image and voice capabilities.
faq.a_zh: 需要更高的质量且预算有限：DeepSeek（文本）+ Flux（图像）+ Kling（视频）；需要单一付费提供商：OpenAI GPT-5（内置图像和语音能力）。

faq.a_en: Developers prototyping multi-modal apps on a zero budget, students learning API integration, and hobbyists exploring AI-generated content without financial commitment.
faq.a_zh: 零预算开发多模态应用原型的开发者、学习 API 集成的学生、以及不希望投入资金探索 AI 生成内容的爱好者。

pricingSummary.en: Pay-as-you-go: Speech-to-Text $0.015/min (real-time $0.024/min) · LeMUR (LLM) $0.002 × 1k chars · Annual volume discounts available.
pricingSummary.zh: 按量计费：语音转文字 $0.015/分钟（实时 $0.024/分钟）；LeMUR（LLM）$0.002/千字符；年付有折扣。

faq.a_en: The API has a free tier (limited hours per month). After that, pay-as-you-go pricing starts at $0.015 per minute for speech-to-text.
faq.a_zh: API 有免费额度（每月有限时长），超出后按量计费，语音转文字 $0.015/分钟起。

faq.a_en: LeMUR is AssemblyAI's framework for applying LLMs to transcribed audio. You can ask questions, generate summaries, extract action items, and classify content from your audio files.
faq.a_zh: LeMUR 是 AssemblyAI 的框架，用于对转写后的音频应用 LLM —— 可提问、生成摘要、提取行动项、分类内容。

faq.a_en: 100+ languages for speech-to-text. Best accuracy on English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Mandarin Chinese.
faq.a_zh: 100+ 语言语音转文字，英/西/法/德/意/葡/日/韩/中文普通话准确率最高。

faq.a_en: Yes. Real-time streaming endpoint with speaker diarization, interim results, and final transcripts. Slightly higher pricing at $0.024/min.
faq.a_zh: 支持实时流式端点，含说话人分离、中间结果和最终转写。价格稍高为 $0.024/分钟。

faq.a_en: Industry-leading for English with word error rate (WER) under 5% on clean audio. Accuracy drops on heavy accents, background noise, or overlapping speech.
faq.a_zh: 英文 WER 低于 5%，行业领先；重口音、背景噪音或多人交叠时准确率下降。

faq.q_zh: AssemblyAI 能区分多个说话人吗？
faq.a_en: Yes. Speaker diarization is built in and configurable. It labels each segment with a speaker ID and supports up to 10+ speakers per audio file.
faq.a_zh: 支持。说话人分离功能内置且可配置，每段标注 speaker ID，支持 10+ 个说话人。

faq.q_zh: AssemblyAI 支持自定义词汇吗？
faq.a_en: Yes. You can provide a custom vocabulary with domain-specific terms, product names, acronyms, and proper nouns to improve accuracy.
faq.a_zh: 支持。可提交自定义词汇表，包含行业术语、产品名、缩写和专有名词来提升准确率。

faq.q_en: How does AssemblyAI compare to Deepgram?
faq.q_zh: AssemblyAI 与 Deepgram 相比如何？
faq.a_en: AssemblyAI offers richer post-processing features (LeMUR LLM, content moderation, summarization). Deepgram has lower latency and stronger custom model options. Both are best-in-class API providers.
faq.a_zh: AssemblyAI 的后处理功能更丰富（LeMUR LLM、内容审核、摘要）；Deepgram 延迟更低、自定义模型更强。两者都是行业顶尖的 API 服务商。

faq.q_en: Is AssemblyAI secure for enterprise use?
faq.a_en: Yes. SOC 2 Type II certified, HIPAA compliance available on Enterprise plan, data encryption at rest and in transit, and data retention policies you can configure.
faq.a_zh: SOC 2 Type II 认证；Enterprise 版支持 HIPAA 合规；传输和静态数据加密；可配置数据保留策略。

faq.q_en: What is the best use case for AssemblyAI?
faq.a_en: Building speech-to-text into your own product: call center analytics, meeting transcription, video captioning, podcast indexing, and voice agent pipelines.
faq.a_zh: 将语音转文字集成到自己的产品中：呼叫中心分析、会议转写、视频字幕、播客索引、语音 Agent 管线。

pricingSummary.en: Free tier with limited daily tokens · Pro $20/mo (2x faster AI, larger context) · Enterprise for teams.
pricingSummary.zh: 免费版每日额度有限；Pro 20 美元/月（2 倍速度、更大上下文）；企业版可按需定制。

faq.a_en: Yes, with a daily token limit. Pro at $20/month removes the cap and gives faster inference.
faq.a_zh: 免费版有每日额度限制；Pro 20 美元/月解除限制并提供更快的推理速度。

faq.q_zh: Bolt 能构建生产级应用吗？
faq.a_en: Best for MVPs, prototypes, and internal tools. Complex production apps with many dependencies may hit the WebContainer sandbox limits. Bolt is excellent for quick validation.
faq.a_zh: 最适合 MVP、原型和内部工具。复杂生产应用可能触及 WebContainer 沙箱限制。Bolt 在快速验证 idea 方面表现出色。

faq.q_en: How does Bolt compare to Lovable?
faq.q_zh: Bolt 与 Lovable 相比如何？
faq.a_en: Bolt runs in a browser-based WebContainer and is better for React/Node.js stacks. Lovable integrates with Supabase out of the box and is better for full-stack apps with databases.
faq.a_zh: Bolt 基于浏览器 WebContainer 运行，更适合 React/Node.js 技术栈；Lovable 内置 Supabase 集成，更适合带数据库的全栈应用。

faq.q_zh: Bolt 支持 GitHub 集成吗？
faq.a_en: Yes. You can push directly to a GitHub repository from the Bolt editor. One-click deploy to Vercel or Netlify is also available.
faq.a_zh: 支持。可直接从 Bolt 编辑器推送到 GitHub 仓库，也支持一键部署到 Vercel 或 Netlify。

faq.q_en: What tech stacks does Bolt support?
faq.a_en: React, Next.js, Vue, Svelte, Node.js, Express, Python (FastAPI), and most npm packages. The WebContainer sandbox has some limitations on native OS calls.
faq.a_zh: React、Next.js、Vue、Svelte、Node.js、Express、Python (FastAPI) 以及大多数 npm 包。WebContainer 沙箱对原生 OS 调用有一定限制。

faq.q_zh: Bolt 能生成 API 吗？
faq.a_en: Yes. Bolt can scaffold REST and GraphQL APIs with Node.js or Python. For production API hosting, you will want to move the code to a dedicated server.
faq.a_zh: 可以。Bolt 能用 Node.js 或 Python 搭建 REST 和 GraphQL API 的脚手架。生产环境建议将代码迁移到专用服务器。

faq.q_en: Is Bolt suitable for learning to code?
faq.a_en: Very. The zero-config environment and browser-based IDE let beginners build real apps immediately without worrying about setup.
faq.a_zh: 非常适合。零配置环境和浏览器 IDE 让初学者直接从构建真实应用入门，无需担心环境配置。

faq.q_en: What are the main alternatives to Bolt?
faq.q_zh: Bolt 的主要替代品是什么？
faq.a_en: Lovable (Supabase + full-stack), v0 (Vercel UI), Replit (cloud IDE), and Cursor (local IDE). Each has a different strength.
faq.a_zh: Lovable（Supabase + 全栈）、v0（Vercel UI）、Replit（云端 IDE）、Cursor（本地 IDE），各有侧重。

faq.a_en: No. Bolt runs entirely in the browser and requires a network connection for both the AI and the WebContainer runtime.
faq.a_zh: 不能。Bolt 完全在浏览器中运行，AI 和 WebContainer 运行环境都需要网络连接。

faq.a_en: Founders building MVPs, developers prototyping ideas quickly, and anyone who wants to go from idea to working app in minutes.
faq.a_zh: 想快速搭建 MVP 的创业者、快速验证想法的开发者、以及想要从 idea 到可运行应用在几分钟内完成的任何人。

pricingSummary.en: Free tier (limited prompt credits) · Pro $20/mo · Team $40/seat/mo · Enterprise custom.
pricingSummary.zh: 免费版有额度限制；Pro 20 美元/月；Team 40 美元/席/月；Enterprise 定制。

faq.a_en: Vercel's AI-powered UI generator. Describe a component or page in natural language, and v0 generates production-ready React + Tailwind code with one-click deploy.
faq.a_zh: Vercel 推出的 AI UI 生成器。用自然语言描述组件或页面，v0 生成可直接部署的 React + Tailwind 代码。

faq.a_en: Free tier with limited monthly credits. Pro at $20/month adds more credits and priority access.
faq.a_zh: 免费版每月有额度限制；Pro 20 美元/月增加额度并享有优先访问。

faq.a_en: React, Next.js, and Vue with Tailwind CSS. Generated components are production-ready and follow accessibility best practices.
faq.a_zh: React、Next.js 和 Vue（搭配 Tailwind CSS）。生成的组件可直接用于生产环境，遵循无障碍最佳实践。

faq.q_zh: v0 能生成完整页面吗？
faq.a_en: Yes. Describe a landing page, dashboard, or form, and v0 generates the full layout with responsive design. You can iterate on specific sections.
faq.a_zh: 可以。描述落地页、仪表盘或表单，v0 会生成完整布局并响应式。你还可以针对特定部分迭代。

faq.q_en: How does v0 compare to Bolt?
faq.q_zh: v0 与 Bolt 相比如何？
faq.a_en: v0 specializes in UI generation (React + Tailwind, one-click deploy to Vercel). Bolt is a full-stack app builder with a WebContainer runtime. Use v0 for UI, Bolt for full apps.
faq.a_zh: v0 专注于 UI 生成（React + Tailwind，一键部署到 Vercel）；Bolt 是全栈应用构建器，内置 WebContainer 运行环境。做 UI 用 v0，做完整应用用 Bolt。

faq.a_en: Yes. The v0 API allows you to generate UI components programmatically, making it possible to integrate into your design-to-code pipeline.
faq.a_zh: 有。v0 API 支持以编程方式生成 UI 组件，可集成到你的设计到代码工作流中。

faq.a_en: No. v0 generates UI code only. For images, use Midjourney, Flux, or DALL-E. For icons, use the bundled Lucide icon library.
faq.a_zh: 不能。v0 只生成 UI 代码；图像请用 Midjourney、Flux 或 DALL-E；图标使用内置的 Lucide 图标库。

faq.q_en: Is v0 good for design systems?
faq.q_zh: v0 适合搭建设计系统吗？
faq.a_en: Yes. You can describe your design tokens, components, and variants, and v0 generates a consistent component library that matches your brand.
faq.a_zh: 适合。描述你的设计 Token、组件和变体后，v0 会生成与品牌一致的一致组件库。

faq.q_en: Can I edit v0 output in VS Code?
faq.q_zh: v0 生成的代码可以在 VS Code 中编辑吗？
faq.a_en: Yes. Export the generated code and open it in any editor. The code is standard React/Vue + Tailwind with no proprietary lock-in.
faq.a_zh: 可以。导出生成的代码即可在任何编辑器中打开。代码是标准的 React/Vue + Tailwind，无供应商锁定。

faq.a_en: Frontend developers who want to ship UI faster, designers who want to turn mockups into code, and full-stack devs who want to skip the boilerplate.
faq.a_zh: 希望更快交付 UI 的前端开发者、想将设计稿转为代码的设计师、想跳过样板代码的全栈开发者。

pricingSummary.en: Free tier (limited) · Starter $20/mo · Launch $50/mo · Scale $100/mo.
pricingSummary.zh: 免费版有限制；Starter 20 美元/月；Launch 50 美元/月；Scale 100 美元/月。

faq.q_en: What makes Lovable different from Bolt?
faq.q_zh: Lovable 与 Bolt 有什么不同？
faq.a_en: Lovable is built around Supabase, so user auth, database, and storage are included from the start. Bolt is better for Node.js/React apps without a database. Lovable is stronger for SaaS MVPs.
faq.a_zh: Lovable 围绕 Supabase 构建，从第一步就包含用户认证、数据库和存储；Bolt 更适合无需数据库的 Node.js/React 应用。Lovable 在 SaaS MVP 方面更强。

faq.q_zh: 非技术背景的创业者能用 Lovable 吗？
faq.a_en: Yes. The chat-to-app interface lets you describe your idea in plain English. Lovable generates the full stack, deploys it, and gives you a live URL.
faq.a_zh: 可以。通过对话式界面，用日常语言描述你的想法，Lovable 会生成完整应用、部署并给你一个可访问的 URL。

faq.q_zh: Lovable 支持自定义域名吗？
faq.a_en: Yes. Paid plans support custom domains. The free tier gives you a lovable.app subdomain.
faq.a_zh: 付费版支持自定义域名；免费版提供 lovable.app 子域名。

faq.q_en: Can I export the code from Lovable?
faq.q_zh: Lovable 的代码可以导出吗？
faq.a_en: Yes. You can export the full project to a GitHub repository and continue developing locally or with your team.
faq.a_zh: 可以。将完整项目导出到 GitHub 仓库即可在本地或与团队继续开发。

faq.q_en: What tech stack does Lovable use?
faq.a_en: React + TypeScript frontend, Supabase for backend (PostgreSQL, auth, storage), and Tailwind CSS. Deployed on Lovable's hosting infrastructure.
faq.a_zh: React + TypeScript 前端，Supabase 后端（PostgreSQL、认证、存储），Tailwind CSS 样式。部署在 Lovable 的托管基础设施上。

faq.q_en: Is Lovable good for internal tools?
faq.q_zh: Lovable 适合做内部工具吗？
faq.a_en: Yes. With Supabase's built-in auth and row-level security, you can build internal dashboards, admin panels, and CRUD apps quickly.
faq.a_zh: 适合。借助 Supabase 内置的认证和行级安全，可以快速搭建内部仪表盘、管理面板和 CRUD 应用。

faq.q_en: How does Lovable pricing compare to Bolt?
faq.q_zh: Lovable 的定价与 Bolt 相比如何？
faq.a_en: Starter at $20/mo is similar to Bolt Pro. Launch at $50/mo adds more generous limits. Both are comparable for MVP development.
faq.a_zh: Starter 20 美元/月与 Bolt Pro 相当；Launch 50 美元/月提供更宽松的额度。两者在 MVP 开发上各有优势。

faq.q_zh: Lovable 能处理复杂逻辑吗？
faq.a_en: It handles CRUD, auth flows, and basic business logic well. For complex algorithms or custom API integrations, you may need to extend the generated code.
faq.a_zh: CRUD、认证流程和基础业务逻辑处理良好；复杂算法或自定义 API 集成可能需要扩展生成的代码。

faq.q_en: Does Lovable have a mobile app?
faq.q_zh: Lovable 有移动端 App 吗？
faq.a_en: No. Lovable generates web apps that are responsive and mobile-friendly. For native mobile apps, consider React Native or Flutter.
faq.a_zh: Lovable 生成的是响应式 Web 应用；原生移动端 App 建议使用 React Native 或 Flutter。

faq.a_en: Non-technical founders building SaaS MVPs, product teams prototyping with real data, and anyone who needs a full-stack app with a database without writing backend code.
faq.a_zh: 构建 SaaS MVP 的非技术创业者、用真实数据做原型的产品团队、以及需要带数据库的全栈应用但不想写后端代码的人。

pricingSummary.en: Free tier (limited compute + AI) · Core $20/mo (unlimited compute + AI agent) · Teams $40/seat/mo.
pricingSummary.zh: 免费版有计算和 AI 额度限制；Core 20 美元/月（无限计算 + AI Agent）；Teams 40 美元/席/月。

faq.a_en: A browser-based cloud IDE with built-in AI. You can code, run, and deploy apps without installing anything. The 2026 Agent mode can build entire features from a description.
faq.a_zh: 基于浏览器的云端 IDE，内置 AI 助手。无需安装即可编码、运行和部署应用。2026 年的 Agent 模式可根据描述自动构建完整功能。

faq.a_en: Free tier includes limited compute and AI credits. Core at $20/month removes the limits and adds the AI agent with full context.
faq.a_zh: 免费版有计算和 AI 额度限制；Core 20 美元/月解除限制并添加全上下文 AI Agent。

faq.a_en: Yes. One-click deploy with a generated URL. Static sites, Node.js, Python, and Go apps are supported. Custom domains on paid plans.
faq.a_zh: 支持一键部署并生成 URL；支持静态网站、Node.js、Python 和 Go 应用；付费版可绑定自定义域名。

faq.q_en: Is Replit good for learning to code?
faq.a_en: Yes. Zero setup, browser-based, and the AI agent explains code as it generates it. Widely used in CS education programs.
faq.a_zh: 非常适合。零配置、基于浏览器，AI Agent 在生成代码的同时会解释原理。广泛用于计算机科学教育。

faq.q_en: How does Replit compare to Cursor?
faq.q_zh: Replit 与 Cursor 相比如何？
faq.a_en: Replit is browser-based and requires no setup — ideal for quick prototypes and learning. Cursor is a local IDE with deeper codebase understanding and better for large projects.
faq.a_zh: Replit 基于浏览器、无需配置——适合快速原型和学习；Cursor 是本地 IDE，代码库理解更深、更适合大型项目。

faq.a_en: 50+ languages including Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Go, Rust, C++, Java, HTML/CSS, Bash, and SQL. Python and JavaScript have the best AI support.
faq.a_zh: 50+ 语言，包括 Python、JavaScript、TypeScript、Go、Rust、C++、Java、HTML/CSS、Bash 和 SQL；Python 和 JavaScript 的 AI 支持最好。

faq.a_en: Yes. Teams plan includes multiplayer editing, shared secrets, and team workspaces. Multiple developers can edit the same repl simultaneously.
faq.a_zh: 支持。Teams 版包含多人实时编辑、共享密钥和团队工作区。多位开发者可同时编辑同一个 Repl。

faq.q_en: Is Replit's Agent mode worth the upgrade?
faq.q_zh: Replit 的 Agent 模式值得升级吗？
faq.a_en: If you build features frequently, yes. The Agent can scaffold, debug, and deploy autonomously — saving hours per feature. The free tier is good for occasional use.
faq.a_zh: 如果经常构建功能，值得。Agent 能自主完成脚手架搭建、调试和部署——每个功能节省数小时。偶尔使用免费版即可。

faq.q_zh: Replit 能运行定时任务吗？
faq.a_en: Yes, with the Always-On feature (paid plans). You can keep a web server running or schedule cron jobs. The free tier sleeps after inactivity.
faq.a_zh: 付费版支持 Always-On 功能，可保持 Web 服务器运行或设置定时任务；免费版闲置后会休眠。

faq.a_en: Students learning to code, developers prototyping quickly, educators teaching programming, and anyone who wants to code from any device without setup.
faq.a_zh: 学习编程的学生、快速原型的开发者、教授编程的教育者、以及任何想在任何设备上无需配置直接编码的人。

pricingSummary.en: Open source under Apache 2.0. Pay only the underlying LLM API (DeepSeek, OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.); free if you use a local model.
pricingSummary.zh: Apache 2.0 开源。LLM API 费用自理（DeepSeek / OpenAI / Anthropic 等）；用本地模型则完全免费。

faq.a_en: Aider is an open-source AI pair-programming tool that runs in your terminal. It edits files in your repo and auto-commits each change to Git.
faq.a_zh: Aider 是跑在终端里的开源 AI 结对编程工具，直接编辑仓库文件并自动为每次修改创建 Git commit。

faq.a_en: Yes. Aider itself is free and open source (Apache 2.0). You only pay for the LLM API you point it at, or run it free with a local model.
faq.a_zh: 免费。Aider 本身是 Apache 2.0 开源；只需为它调用的 LLM API 付费，或者用本地模型即可完全免费。

faq.a_en: Aider works with most frontier LLMs through API keys or local servers: DeepSeek, Claude, GPT, Gemini, Llama, Qwen, and Ollama-served models.
faq.a_zh: Aider 通过 API key 或本地服务器对接主流前沿模型：DeepSeek、Claude、GPT、Gemini、Llama、Qwen 以及 Ollama 本地模型。

faq.q_en: How is Aider different from Cursor or Windsurf?
faq.q_zh: Aider 和 Cursor、Windsurf 有什么不同？
faq.a_en: Aider is purely a command-line tool with no GUI; it integrates with any editor via your terminal. Cursor and Windsurf are full IDEs with graphical UIs.
faq.a_zh: Aider 是纯命令行工具，没有 GUI，通过终端与任意编辑器配合；Cursor 和 Windsurf 是带图形界面的完整 IDE。

faq.q_zh: Aider 会自动创建 Git 提交吗？
faq.a_en: Yes. Every accepted change is committed with a descriptive message you can review with /undo.
faq.a_zh: 会。每次接受的修改都会以可读消息提交，可用 /undo 撤销。

faq.q_en: What languages does Aider work with?
faq.a_en: Aider handles Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java, C/C++, Ruby, PHP and most other popular languages. It uses tree-sitter to map edits to existing code structure.
faq.a_zh: Aider 支持 Python / JavaScript / TypeScript / Go / Rust / Java / C/C++ / Ruby / PHP 等主流语言，用 tree-sitter 把改动映射到既有代码结构。

faq.q_en: Can Aider work on a whole repository?
faq.q_zh: Aider 能处理整个代码库吗？
faq.a_en: Yes. Aider builds a repo map of your codebase so the model can reason across files, useful for multi-file refactors.
faq.a_zh: 可以。Aider 会构建代码库映射图，让模型跨文件推理，适合多文件重构。

faq.q_en: Does Aider need a code editor extension?
faq.q_zh: Aider 需要编辑器插件吗？
faq.a_en: No. Aider runs in a terminal and works alongside any editor (VS Code, Neovim, JetBrains, etc.) as a side process.
faq.a_zh: 不需要。Aider 在终端运行，可与任意编辑器（VS Code / Neovim / JetBrains 等）并行。

faq.a_en: Voice is not built in. You can pipe any system voice-to-text tool (Whisper, Mac Dictation) into Aider's input.
faq.a_zh: 没有内置语音。可用系统语音转文字工具（Whisper、Mac Dictation 等）作为 Aider 的输入。

faq.a_en: Terminal-native developers who want fine-grained control, prefer open source, and already use Git heavily.
faq.a_zh: 终端原生派、喜欢开源、深度使用 Git 的开发者。

pricingSummary.en: Black Forest Labs API: Pro ~$0.05 per image at 1MP. Free credits on signup; otherwise usage-based.
pricingSummary.zh: Black Forest Labs API：Pro 版每张 1MP 图约 $0.05。新用户有免费额度，之后按调用量计费。

faq.a_en: Flux is a family of image generation models from Black Forest Labs, the team behind Stable Diffusion. Flux.1 ships in Pro, Dev, and Schnell variants.
faq.a_zh: Flux 是来自 Stable Diffusion 原班人马 Black Forest Labs 的图像生成模型家族，分 Pro / Dev / Schnell 三档。

faq.a_en: Flux.1 Pro produces competitive photorealism and excellent prompt adherence; Midjourney still leads in painterly aesthetics. Choose by use case.
faq.a_zh: Flux.1 Pro 在照片写实与提示词忠实度上很有竞争力；Midjourney 在绘画风格上仍占优。按场景选择。

faq.a_en: Flux is usage-based via the Black Forest Labs API. Flux.1 Pro is roughly $0.05 per 1MP image; Schnell (faster) is cheaper.
faq.a_zh: 通过 Black Forest Labs API 按用量计费，Flux.1 Pro 每张 1MP 图约 $0.05，Schnell（更快）更便宜。

faq.q_en: Does Flux have a free tier?
faq.a_en: Sign-up credits are available, after which it is paid. The open-weight Schnell and Dev variants can be self-hosted for free on your own GPUs.
faq.a_zh: 注册时赠送额度，之后收费。Schnell 和 Dev 的开源权重可自行部署在自有 GPU 上完全免费。

faq.a_en: Yes. The non-commercial FLUX.1 [schnell] and FLUX.1 [dev] weights are released under Apache 2.0 / FLUX.1-dev Non-Commercial License respectively.
faq.a_zh: 可以。FLUX.1 [schnell] 用 Apache 2.0；FLUX.1 [dev] 用 FLUX.1-dev 非商用许可。

faq.a_en: Flux is available on Replicate, fal.ai, Together AI, and through ComfyUI, with new integrations shipping monthly.
faq.a_zh: Flux 可在 Replicate、fal.ai、Together AI 上调用，也支持 ComfyUI；新集成持续增加。

faq.q_en: Is Flux good for typography in images?
faq.q_zh: Flux 处理图像里的文字效果好吗？
faq.a_en: Flux.1 is markedly better at rendering legible text in images than earlier open models, but Ideogram still leads at very long or multilingual strings.
faq.a_zh: Flux.1 在图像内文字渲染清晰度上明显优于早期开源模型，但长文本或多语种文字仍以 Ideogram 最强。

faq.a_en: FLUX.1 [pro] is a 12B parameter rectified flow transformer. Dev and Schnell are similar scale with different training recipes.
faq.a_zh: FLUX.1 [pro] 是 12B 参数的 rectified flow transformer。Dev 和 Schnell 同等规模，训练方式不同。

faq.q_en: Does Flux support LoRA and ControlNet?
faq.q_zh: Flux 支持 LoRA 和 ControlNet 吗？
faq.a_en: The open-weight Dev variant supports LoRA training and ControlNet-style conditioning through ComfyUI and diffusers.
faq.a_zh: 开源的 Dev 版本支持 LoRA 训练和 ControlNet 风格条件控制，可通过 ComfyUI 与 diffusers 使用。

faq.a_en: Teams that need a flexible image model with both an API and self-hosting path, especially if text-in-image accuracy matters.
faq.a_zh: 既需要 API 又希望自部署、且在意图像内文字准确度的团队。

pricingSummary.en: Free tier with daily generations · Basic $8/mo, Plus $16/mo, Pro $48/mo unlock more generations, private mode, and higher resolution.
pricingSummary.zh: 免费版含每日生成额度；Basic 8 美元/月、Plus 16 美元/月、Pro 48 美元/月，解锁更多生成、私密模式与更高分辨率。

faq.a_en: Ideogram is an AI image generator from a Toronto-based team of ex-Google researchers, focused on accurate text rendering inside images.
faq.a_zh: Ideogram 是多伦多团队（前 Google 研究员）做的 AI 图像生成器，专注图像内文字渲染。

faq.a_en: Yes. The free plan allows a daily quota of generations; paid plans start at $8/month.
faq.a_zh: 免费版有每日生成额度；付费版从 8 美元/月起。

faq.q_en: Why is Ideogram good at text in images?
faq.q_zh: Ideogram 为什么擅长处理图像里的文字？
faq.a_en: Ideogram's architecture and training data are optimized for typographic accuracy, which is the hardest problem for most diffusion models.
faq.a_zh: Ideogram 的架构与训练数据专门针对排版准确度优化，而这正是大多数扩散模型最难的部分。

faq.q_en: How does Ideogram compare to Midjourney?
faq.q_zh: Ideogram 和 Midjourney 怎么比？
faq.a_en: Midjourney produces more aesthetic imagery; Ideogram wins for posters, logos, mockups, and any image that contains real text.
faq.a_zh: Midjourney 风格化更强；Ideogram 在海报、Logo、Mockup 等含真实文字的场景占优。

faq.a_en: Yes. The Ideogram API exposes image generation, inpainting, and style references for paid users.
faq.a_zh: 有。付费用户可使用 Ideogram API 接入图像生成、局部重绘和风格参考。

faq.a_en: Canvas is Ideogram's in-browser editor for extending, inpainting, and re-styling generated images.
faq.a_zh: Canvas 是 Ideogram 的浏览器内编辑器，用于扩展、局部重绘和风格化重做。

faq.q_en: Can I use Ideogram images commercially?
faq.q_zh: Ideogram 生成的图商用合法吗？
faq.a_en: Paid plans include commercial usage rights; the free plan is for personal use. Always check the latest terms on Ideogram's site.
faq.a_zh: 付费版含商用许可；免费版仅供个人使用。最新条款以 Ideogram 官网为准。

faq.q_en: What aspect ratios does Ideogram support?
faq.a_en: Ideogram supports square, portrait, landscape and several print/social aspect ratios up to high resolutions on paid plans.
faq.a_zh: Ideogram 支持方形、竖版、横版以及多种印刷/社交画幅，付费版支持更高分辨率。

faq.q_en: Does Ideogram support styles and references?
faq.q_zh: Ideogram 支持风格和参考图吗？
faq.a_en: Yes. You can upload a style or character reference to maintain visual consistency across generations.
faq.a_zh: 支持。可上传风格或角色参考图，在多次生成间保持视觉一致性。

faq.a_en: Designers, marketers, and indie founders who need on-brand visuals with real text inside them.
faq.a_zh: 需要带真实文字、又符合品牌调性视觉的设计师、营销人和独立创始人。

pricingSummary.en: Free tier with slow queue · Basic $10/mo, Pro $30/mo unlock real-time generation, higher resolution, and faster queue.
pricingSummary.zh: 免费版排队较慢；Basic 10 美元/月、Pro 30 美元/月，解锁实时生成、更高分辨率与更快队列。

faq.a_en: Krea is an AI image and video tool focused on real-time generation — you paint or sketch and the model updates the canvas live.
faq.a_zh: Krea 是主打实时生成的 AI 图像/视频工具：你边画/边涂，模型同步更新画面。

faq.a_en: Yes. There is a free plan with a slow queue; paid plans start at $10/month for faster real-time output.
faq.a_zh: 免费版有，但排队较慢；付费版从 10 美元/月起，速度更快。

faq.q_en: How does Krea's real-time generation work?
faq.q_zh: Krea 实时生成怎么实现？
faq.a_en: Krea streams a small diffusion model that re-generates the canvas continuously as you sketch, achieving sub-second feedback.
faq.a_zh: Krea 跑的是小型扩散模型流，边画边持续重绘画面，反馈延迟低于 1 秒。

faq.a_en: Yes. Krea Video extends the same real-time UI to short video clips and keyframe animation.
faq.a_zh: 支持。Krea Video 把同一实时交互延伸到短视频片段和关键帧动画。

faq.q_en: Can I use Krea for logos?
faq.q_zh: Krea 适合做 Logo 吗？
faq.a_en: Krea is great for ideation but final logo work usually needs a vector tool (Figma, Illustrator) and a dedicated typography model.
faq.a_zh: Krea 适合做前期概念；最终 Logo 通常要在矢量工具（Figma / Illustrator）和专业字体模型中完成。

faq.a_en: Krea is web-app only today; an API has been teased but is not generally available as of mid-2026.
faq.a_zh: 目前只有 Web 版；API 已有预告，截至 2026 年中尚未正式开放。

faq.a_en: Krea Diffusion is the company's text-to-image model that is also available through partner platforms like Replicate.
faq.a_zh: Krea Diffusion 是该公司的文生图模型，也通过 Replicate 等平台开放。

faq.q_en: How good is Krea for product mockups?
faq.q_zh: Krea 做产品 Mockup 效果好吗？
faq.a_en: Krea is strong for stylised mockups and concept art; for photoreal product shots, Flux Pro or Midjourney still lead.
faq.a_zh: Krea 在风格化 Mockup 和概念图上很强；写实产品图仍以 Flux Pro 或 Midjourney 为佳。

faq.q_en: Can I bring my own LoRA to Krea?
faq.q_zh: Krea 支持导入自定义 LoRA 吗？
faq.a_en: Paid plans allow private LoRAs trained on Krea, useful for consistent character or product looks.
faq.a_zh: 付费版支持训练私有 LoRA，用于角色或产品的视觉一致性。

faq.a_en: Designers, concept artists, and creative directors who iterate visually and want immediate feedback.
faq.a_zh: 需要快速视觉迭代的设计师、概念艺术家和创意总监。

pricingSummary.en: Free tier with Magic Studio basics · Pro $13/mo, Teams $30/mo (5 seats) unlock Magic Studio, Brand Kit, background remover, and full template library.
pricingSummary.zh: 免费版含 Magic Studio 基础功能；Pro 13 美元/月、Teams 30 美元/月（5 席）解锁 Magic Studio、品牌工具箱、抠图与全模板库。

faq.a_en: Canva AI is the AI feature set inside Canva (Magic Write, Magic Design, Magic Edit, Magic Animate) that helps non-designers create on-brand visuals.
faq.a_zh: Canva AI 是 Canva 内置的 AI 功能集（Magic Write、Magic Design、Magic Edit、Magic Animate），帮助非设计师产出符合品牌调性的视觉。

faq.a_en: Yes. The free plan is generous; Pro ($13/mo) unlocks Magic Studio and the full template library.
faq.a_zh: 免费版已够用；Pro 13 美元/月解锁 Magic Studio 与全模板库。

faq.q_en: Do I need design skills to use Canva AI?
faq.q_zh: 用 Canva AI 需要设计基础吗？
faq.a_en: No. Canva is built for non-designers; Magic Design can produce a complete layout from a text prompt or a single image.
faq.a_zh: 不需要。Canva 面向非设计师；Magic Design 可以从一段文字或一张图直接生成完整版式。

faq.q_en: How good is Canva AI at generating images?
faq.q_zh: Canva AI 生成图像效果如何？
faq.a_en: Canva's image generation is convenient and on-brand but not state-of-the-art; for hero art, designers still prefer Midjourney or Flux Pro.
faq.a_zh: Canva 的图像生成好用且符合品牌，但并非最强；高质量主视觉设计师仍多选 Midjourney 或 Flux Pro。

faq.q_en: Does Canva AI support brand consistency?
faq.q_zh: Canva AI 支持品牌一致性吗？
faq.a_en: Yes. Brand Kit (Pro and above) lets Magic Studio pull colors, fonts, and logos so every generated asset stays on-brand.
faq.a_zh: 支持。Pro 及以上的 Brand Kit 让 Magic Studio 自动应用品牌色、字体和 Logo，生成物保持品牌一致。

faq.q_en: Can I use Canva AI to make presentations?
faq.q_zh: Canva AI 能做演示文稿吗？
faq.a_en: Yes. Magic Design for Presentations generates full decks from a topic or document; teams can also use AI to summarise existing slides.
faq.a_zh: 可以。Magic Design for Presentations 能根据主题或文档生成完整 PPT；也能用 AI 总结已有幻灯片。

faq.a_en: Canva exposes a Connect API for assets, exports, and design automation; full AI features are not yet available via API.
faq.a_zh: Canva 提供 Connect API 用于素材、导出和设计自动化；完整 AI 功能尚未通过 API 开放。

faq.a_en: Yes. The background remover is one of the most popular tools, included on Pro plans and above.
faq.a_zh: 可以。抠图是 Pro 及以上最受欢迎的功能之一。

faq.a_en: Yes. Pro unlocks CMYK export and high-resolution PNG/PDF suitable for print, including business cards, posters, and merch.
faq.a_zh: 可以。Pro 解锁 CMYK 导出和高分辨率 PNG/PDF，可用于名片、海报和周边印刷。

faq.a_en: Small business owners, marketers, teachers, and anyone who needs polished visuals without learning Photoshop.
faq.a_zh: 中小企业主、营销人、教师，以及不想学 Photoshop 又需要出图的人。

pricingSummary.en: Free tier with watermark · Standard $10/mo, Pro $35/mo, Premier $95/mo unlock more credits, higher resolution, and no watermark.
pricingSummary.zh: 免费版带水印；Standard 10 美元/月、Pro 35 美元/月、Premier 95 美元/月，解锁更多积分、更高分辨率、去水印。

faq.a_en: Pika is an AI video generation platform that turns text, image, and video prompts into short cinematic clips, with strong motion and camera controls.
faq.a_zh: Pika 是 AI 视频生成平台，能把文字、图像和视频提示生成短视频片段，运动和镜头控制是其强项。

faq.a_en: Yes. The free plan produces watermarked clips; paid plans start at $10/month for higher resolution and no watermark.
faq.a_zh: 免费版会带水印；付费版从 10 美元/月起，去水印且分辨率更高。

faq.q_en: How long can Pika videos be?
faq.q_zh: Pika 视频最长能生成多久？
faq.a_en: Pika generates clips up to 10 seconds per generation on paid plans, which can be chained using Pikaffects or extended in the timeline.
faq.a_zh: 付费版每次生成最长约 10 秒，可通过 Pikaffects 或时间线串联延长。

faq.q_en: How does Pika compare to Sora?
faq.q_zh: Pika 和 Sora 怎么比？
faq.a_en: Pika emphasizes controllability — Pikaffects, motion strength, camera direction — while Sora leans on raw realism. Pika is faster and cheaper for iterative work.
faq.a_zh: Pika 强调可控性（Pikaffects、运动强度、镜头方向），Sora 偏重真实感。Pika 在迭代速度和成本上更友好。

faq.a_en: Yes. Image-to-video is one of Pika's strongest features: upload a still and Pika animates it with motion and camera prompts.
faq.a_zh: 支持。图生视频是 Pika 强项：上传静态图，配上运动和镜头提示即可动起来。

faq.q_en: Can I edit an existing video with Pika?
faq.q_zh: Pika 能编辑现有视频吗？
faq.a_en: Yes. Pika lets you upload a video and apply Pikaffects to restyle, re-light, or extend it.
faq.a_zh: 可以。可上传视频并应用 Pikaffects 改风格、改光效或延长。

faq.a_en: Pika offers a developer API for paid accounts, suitable for batch rendering and app integration.
faq.a_zh: 有。付费账户可使用开发者 API，适合批量渲染和应用集成。

faq.a_en: Pikaffects are one-click video transformations like 'melt', 'inflate', 'crush', 'cake-ify' applied to uploaded clips or images.
faq.a_zh: Pikaffects 是一键视频变换效果，如 melt、inflate、crush、cake-ify，可作用在上传的片段或图像上。

faq.a_en: Pika focuses on visuals; audio is not generated. Pair with ElevenLabs for voice and Suno for music.
faq.a_zh: Pika 专注画面，不生成声音。配音用 ElevenLabs，配乐用 Suno。

faq.a_en: Creators and marketers producing short social clips, music videos, and stylized content where motion and effects matter more than photorealism.
faq.a_zh: 做短视频社媒、音乐 MV、风格化内容的创作者和营销人。

pricingSummary.en: Free tier with daily generations · Standard $9.99/mo, Pro $29.99/mo, Premier $99.99/mo unlock more generations, higher resolution, and priority queue.
pricingSummary.zh: 免费版含每日生成额度；Standard 9.99 美元/月、Pro 29.99 美元/月、Premier 99.99 美元/月，解锁更多生成、更高分辨率与优先队列。

faq.a_en: Luma is an AI video generation company best known for Dream Machine, which turns text and image prompts into realistic short videos.
faq.a_zh: Luma 是 AI 视频生成公司，旗下 Dream Machine 可将文字和图像提示生成写实短视频。

faq.a_en: Yes. Luma offers a free tier with daily generations; paid plans start at $9.99/month for more generations and higher resolution.
faq.a_zh: 免费版有每日生成额度；付费版从 9.99 美元/月起，生成数量更多、分辨率更高。

faq.q_en: How does Luma compare to Sora?
faq.q_zh: Luma 和 Sora 怎么比？
faq.a_en: Luma's Dream Machine is competitive on realism and faster on iteration; Sora still leads on long-form coherent shots. Pick by workflow speed vs. shot length.
faq.a_zh: Dream Machine 在写实度和迭代速度上很强；Sora 在长镜头连贯性上仍占优。按工作流速度 vs 镜头长度选。

faq.a_en: Yes. Image-to-video is one of Dream Machine's strongest paths: upload a still, prompt the motion, get a 5-second clip.
faq.a_zh: 支持。图生视频是 Dream Machine 最佳路径之一：上传静态图，描述运动，生成 5 秒片段。

faq.a_en: Yes. You can extend a clip by using its last frame as a new keyframe and prompting the next 5 seconds.
faq.a_zh: 可以。可用片段末帧作为新关键帧，再续 5 秒。

faq.a_en: Ray2 is Luma's latest video model, with improved physics, prompt adherence, and human motion quality over Ray1.
faq.a_zh: Ray2 是 Luma 最新视频模型，相比 Ray1 物理感、提示词忠实度和人物动作质量都更好。

faq.a_en: Yes. Luma exposes a REST API for Dream Machine and Ray2, useful for batch workflows and app integration.
faq.a_zh: 有。Luma 提供 Dream Machine 和 Ray2 的 REST API，适合批量工作流与应用集成。

faq.q_en: Is Luma good for product videos?
faq.q_zh: Luma 适合做产品视频吗？
faq.a_en: Yes. Many brands use Dream Machine to animate product stills into 5-second looping clips for social ads.
faq.a_zh: 可以。很多品牌用 Dream Machine 把产品静图做成 5 秒循环短视频用于社交广告。

faq.a_en: Luma focuses on visuals. For voiceover, use ElevenLabs; for music, use Suno or Udio.
faq.a_zh: Luma 专注画面。配音用 ElevenLabs，配乐用 Suno 或 Udio。

faq.a_en: Creators who need fast, realistic image-to-video and don't mind short clip lengths that can be chained.
faq.a_zh: 需要快速、逼真图生视频、不介意短片段可串联的创作者。

pricingSummary.en: Free tier with daily credits · Standard $5.99/mo, Pro $9.99/mo, Premier $29.99/mo unlock more credits, longer clips, and priority queue.
pricingSummary.zh: 免费版有每日积分；Standard 5.99 美元/月、Pro 9.99 美元/月、Premier 29.99 美元/月，解锁更多积分、更长片段与优先队列。

faq.a_en: Kling is an AI video generation model from Kuaishou, popular for realistic human motion and competitive image-to-video at low cost.
faq.a_zh: Kling 是快手推出的 AI 视频生成模型，以真实人物动作和性价比图生视频著称。

faq.a_en: Yes. Free users get daily credits; paid plans start at $5.99/month and offer more credits and longer videos.
faq.a_zh: 免费用户有每日积分；付费版从 5.99 美元/月起，积分更多、片段更长。

faq.q_en: How does Kling compare to Sora?
faq.q_zh: Kling 和 Sora 怎么比？
faq.a_en: Kling is strong on realistic human motion, choreography, and image-to-video at a fraction of Sora's price. Sora still leads on long coherent shots and prompt fidelity.
faq.a_zh: Kling 在真实人物动作、舞蹈和图生视频上很强，价格只有 Sora 一小部分。Sora 在长镜头连贯性和提示忠实度上仍占优。

faq.q_en: How long can Kling videos be?
faq.q_zh: Kling 视频最长能生成多久？
faq.a_en: Paid plans can generate up to ~10 seconds per clip; clips can be chained in the editor for longer sequences.
faq.a_zh: 付费版每次生成约 10 秒，可在编辑器中串联成更长的序列。

faq.a_en: Yes. Image-to-video is one of Kling's strongest paths and supports both start and end frames for controlled motion.
faq.a_zh: 支持。图生视频是 Kling 强项之一，支持起止双关键帧，运动控制更准。

faq.a_en: Yes. Kuaishou exposes the Kling API for paid accounts, popular for batch generation in apps.
faq.a_zh: 有。快手为付费账户开放 Kling API，在应用内做批量生成很常用。

faq.q_en: How good is Kling at human motion?
faq.q_zh: Kling 处理人物动作效果如何？
faq.a_en: Kling is widely regarded as the strongest open-platform model for natural human motion, dance, and lip sync in 2026.
faq.a_zh: Kling 被广泛认为是 2026 年在自然人物动作、舞蹈和口型同步上最强的开放平台模型。

faq.a_en: Kling is available in most regions but pricing and access vary; check the Kuaishou Kling site for your country.
faq.a_zh: Kling 多数地区可访问，但价格和可用性因国家不同；请以快手 Kling 官网为准。

faq.a_en: Kling focuses on visuals. Voice and music are not generated; pair with ElevenLabs / Suno.
faq.a_zh: Kling 专注画面，不生成声音与配乐；用 ElevenLabs / Suno 补。

faq.a_en: Creators and indie studios producing social videos, dance content, and short ads that rely on realistic human motion.
faq.a_zh: 需要真实人物动作的短视频、舞蹈内容和广告片的创作者及独立工作室。

pricingSummary.en: Free tier with daily generations · Standard $9.90/mo, Pro $29.90/mo, Premier $59.90/mo unlock more credits, longer clips, and higher resolution.
pricingSummary.zh: 免费版含每日生成；Standard 9.90 美元/月、Pro 29.90 美元/月、Premier 59.90 美元/月，解锁更多积分、更长片段与更高分辨率。

faq.a_en: Hailuo AI is MiniMax's text-to-video and image-to-video product, offering competitive quality at very low or zero cost for short clips.
faq.a_zh: Hailuo AI 是 MiniMax 的文生视频/图生视频产品，以极低或零成本提供有竞争力的短视频质量。

faq.a_en: Yes. Hailuo offers a generous free tier that has historically been the cheapest credible way to get AI video clips in 2026.
faq.a_zh: 免费。Hailuo 的免费额度在 2026 年一直是最便宜的可靠 AI 短视频来源之一。

faq.q_en: How does Hailuo compare to Sora?
faq.q_zh: Hailuo 和 Sora 怎么比？
faq.a_en: Hailuo delivers competitive realism and human motion at a fraction of the price; Sora still leads on prompt fidelity and longer coherent shots.
faq.a_zh: Hailuo 在写实度和人物动作上有竞争力，价格却便宜很多；Sora 在提示忠实度和长镜头连贯性上仍占优。

faq.q_en: How long can Hailuo videos be?
faq.q_zh: Hailuo 视频最长能生成多久？
faq.a_en: Hailuo generates clips around 6 seconds per generation; you can extend or stitch them in the editor.
faq.a_zh: 每次约 6 秒，可在编辑器中延长或拼接。

faq.a_en: Yes. Image-to-video is a core path, popular for animating product photos and portraits.
faq.a_zh: 支持。图生视频是核心路径，常用于让产品图和人像动起来。

faq.a_en: An API exists for enterprise partners; consumer API access has been expanding region by region through 2026.
faq.a_zh: 企业合作伙伴可使用 API；消费级 API 在 2026 年逐步按地区开放。

faq.q_en: How good is Hailuo at human motion?
faq.q_zh: Hailuo 处理人物动作效果如何？
faq.a_en: Hailuo is competitive with Kling and Luma on natural motion, especially for portrait and upper-body shots.
faq.a_zh: Hailuo 在自然人物动作上与 Kling、Luma 相当，尤其在半身和肖像镜头表现稳定。

faq.q_zh: Hailuo 能生成竖版视频吗？
faq.a_en: Yes. Vertical (9:16) is a first-class aspect ratio in Hailuo, ideal for TikTok, Reels, and Shorts.
faq.a_zh: 可以。竖版 9:16 是 Hailuo 一级画幅，适合 TikTok、Reels、Shorts。

faq.a_en: Hailuo focuses on visuals; pair with ElevenLabs for voice and Suno for music.
faq.a_zh: Hailuo 专注画面；用 ElevenLabs 配音，Suno 配乐。

faq.a_en: Creators who want the cheapest credible AI video for social clips, without paying Sora-tier prices.
faq.a_zh: 想用最便宜的可信 AI 视频做社媒短视频、又不想付 Sora 级价格的创作者。

pricingSummary.en: Free tier with limited transcripts · Pro $10/seat/mo, Business $19/seat/mo, Enterprise custom unlock unlimited transcripts, AI apps, and CRM sync.
pricingSummary.zh: 免费版转写有限额；Pro 10 美元/席位/月、Business 19 美元/席位/月、Enterprise 定制价，解锁无限转写、AI 应用与 CRM 同步。

faq.a_en: Fireflies.ai is an AI meeting assistant that records, transcribes, and summarises meetings across Zoom, Google Meet, Teams, and Webex.
faq.a_zh: Fireflies.ai 是 AI 会议助手，可在 Zoom、Google Meet、Teams、Webex 上录音、转写和总结会议。

faq.a_en: Yes. The free plan includes a limited number of transcription credits; paid plans start at $10/seat/month.
faq.a_zh: 免费版含有限转写额度；付费版从 10 美元/席位/月起。

faq.a_en: Fireflies achieves high accuracy on clear English audio; noisy or accented audio benefits from manual speaker labelling and post-editing.
faq.a_zh: Fireflies 在清晰英文音频上准确度较高；噪音或带口音音频建议手动标注说话人并后期校对。

faq.q_zh: Fireflies 支持 CRM 集成吗？
faq.a_en: Yes. Native integrations with Salesforce, HubSpot, Pipedrive, Zoho, and others auto-log meeting notes and call summaries to the right record.
faq.a_zh: 支持。原生集成 Salesforce、HubSpot、Pipedrive、Zoho 等，自动把会议纪要写入对应记录。

faq.q_en: Can Fireflies answer questions about past meetings?
faq.q_zh: Fireflies 能基于历史会议回答问题吗？
faq.a_en: Yes. AskFred is Fireflies' chat assistant that can search across your meeting archive and answer questions in natural language.
faq.a_zh: 可以。AskFred 是 Fireflies 的聊天助手，可跨会议档案自然语言问答。

faq.a_en: Yes. A REST API and webhooks are available, useful for piping meeting data into custom workflows or data warehouses.
faq.a_zh: 有。提供 REST API 与 Webhook，可把会议数据接入自定义工作流或数据仓库。

faq.a_en: Yes. Fireflies offers GDPR-compliant data handling, SOC 2 Type II, and configurable data retention policies on Business and above.
faq.a_zh: 符合。Fireflies 提供 GDPR 合规、SOC 2 Type II 认证，Business 及以上可配置数据保留策略。

faq.q_zh: Fireflies 能识别待办事项吗？
faq.a_en: Yes. Fireflies auto-detects tasks and decisions in the transcript and surfaces them in the summary and in integrated CRMs.
faq.a_zh: 可以。Fireflies 自动从转写中识别任务和决定，并在纪要里和集成 CRM 中呈现。

faq.a_en: Fireflies supports multiple languages including Mandarin, with quality improving for clearly pronounced audio.
faq.a_zh: 支持，包括普通话，发音清晰的音频效果更好。

faq.a_en: Sales teams, customer success, recruiters, and anyone whose calendar is full of meetings they need to remember and act on.
faq.a_zh: 销售、客户成功、招聘，以及会议密集、又需要记住并跟进的人。

pricingSummary.en: Free tier with 300 min/month · Pro $16.99/seat/mo, Business $30/seat/mo unlock more minutes, AI chat, and team features.
pricingSummary.zh: 免费版每月 300 分钟；Pro 16.99 美元/席位/月、Business 30 美元/席位/月，解锁更多时长、AI 问答和团队功能。

faq.a_en: Otter.ai is an AI meeting transcription and note-taking service that joins Zoom, Google Meet, and Teams to capture conversations in real time.
faq.a_zh: Otter.ai 是 AI 会议转写与笔记服务，可加入 Zoom、Google Meet、Teams 实时记录对话。

faq.a_en: Yes. The free plan includes 300 minutes per month; Pro starts at $16.99/seat/month with more minutes and AI features.
faq.a_zh: 免费版每月 300 分钟；Pro 16.99 美元/席位/月起，含更多时长和 AI 功能。

faq.a_en: Otter achieves high accuracy on clear English audio and improving accuracy on Mandarin and other major languages.
faq.a_zh: Otter 在清晰英文音频上准确度很高，普通话和其它主要语言也在持续提升。

faq.q_en: Does Otter have an AI chat?
faq.q_zh: Otter 有 AI 问答吗？
faq.a_en: Yes. Otter AI Chat can answer questions across past meetings, draft follow-up emails, and generate status updates from your meeting archive.
faq.a_zh: 有。Otter AI Chat 可跨历史会议问答、起草跟进邮件、基于会议档案生成状态更新。

faq.q_zh: Otter 能自动加入会议吗？
faq.a_en: Yes. Connect your calendar and Otter auto-joins Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams meetings you host or are invited to.
faq.a_zh: 可以。连接日历后，Otter 会自动加入你主持或受邀的 Zoom、Google Meet、Teams 会议。

faq.a_en: Yes. Otter exposes a REST API and webhooks for paid plans, popular for piping transcripts into CRMs and note apps.
faq.a_zh: 有。付费版提供 REST API 与 Webhook，常用于把转写接入 CRM 和笔记应用。

faq.q_en: How is Otter different from Fireflies?
faq.q_zh: Otter 和 Fireflies 怎么选？
faq.a_en: Otter is a stronger individual note-taker with AI chat; Fireflies is stronger on CRM automation and team-wide search.
faq.a_zh: Otter 在个人笔记和 AI 问答上更强；Fireflies 在 CRM 自动化和团队搜索上更强。

faq.a_en: Yes. Otter detects and labels different speakers automatically and you can correct labels afterwards.
faq.a_zh: 可以。Otter 自动检测并标记不同说话人，之后可手动修正。

faq.q_zh: Otter 适合做课堂笔记吗？
faq.a_en: Yes. Otter is widely used by students and academics; the free 300 min/month covers most semester workloads.
faq.a_zh: 可以。Otter 被学生和学者广泛使用；免费版每月 300 分钟基本覆盖整个学期。

faq.a_en: Students, journalists, researchers, and professionals who need reliable transcripts and searchable meeting history.
faq.a_zh: 学生、记者、研究者，以及需要可靠转写和可搜索会议记录的专业人士。

pricingSummary.zh: 免费版 400 AI 积分；Plus 8 美元/席位/月、Pro 16 美元/席位/月，解锁更多积分、自定义品牌、分析与优先队列。

faq.a_en: Gamma is an AI presentation tool that generates full slide decks from a text prompt, then lets you edit them in a Notion-like interface.
faq.a_zh: Gamma 是 AI 演示工具，能根据文字提示生成完整 PPT，并在 Notion 风格界面中编辑。

faq.a_en: Yes. Free users get 400 AI credits to start; paid plans start at $8/seat/month.
faq.a_zh: 免费用户有 400 AI 积分；付费版从 8 美元/席位/月起。

faq.q_en: How does Gamma compare to PowerPoint?
faq.q_zh: Gamma 和 PowerPoint 怎么比？
faq.a_en: Gamma is faster for first drafts from a prompt; PowerPoint still wins on pixel-perfect control and complex animations for enterprise decks.
faq.a_zh: Gamma 在根据提示快速出首稿上更快；企业级精细控制和复杂动画仍以 PowerPoint 为佳。

faq.q_en: Can I export Gamma decks to PowerPoint?
faq.q_zh: Gamma 能导出为 PowerPoint 吗？
faq.a_en: Yes. Gamma exports to PPTX and PDF; web links can also be shared as interactive presentations.
faq.a_zh: 可以。Gamma 可导出为 PPTX 和 PDF；也可以网页链接形式分享互动演示。

faq.q_zh: Gamma 支持自定义品牌吗？
faq.a_en: Yes. Pro and above let you upload logos, brand colors, and fonts that apply across all generated decks.
faq.a_zh: 支持。Pro 及以上可上传 Logo、品牌色和字体，应用于所有生成的演示。

faq.q_en: Can Gamma generate from a document?
faq.q_zh: Gamma 能从文档生成演示吗？
faq.a_en: Yes. Paste a document or import a URL and Gamma will summarise it into a structured deck.
faq.a_zh: 可以。粘贴文档或导入 URL，Gamma 会自动总结为结构化演示。

faq.a_en: An API is available for paid accounts, useful for embedding Gamma generation inside SaaS workflows.
faq.a_zh: 付费账户可使用 API，可在 SaaS 工作流中嵌入 Gamma 生成。

faq.q_en: Is Gamma good for internal updates?
faq.q_zh: Gamma 适合做内部汇报吗？
faq.a_en: Yes. Many teams use Gamma to turn weekly notes or dashboards into fast status decks; engagement analytics on Pro help track reads.
faq.a_zh: 适合。很多团队用 Gamma 把周报或数据看板转成快速状态汇报，Pro 的参与度分析还能追踪阅读情况。

faq.a_en: Yes. Real-time co-editing and comments work like in Notion or Google Docs.
faq.a_zh: 支持。实时协作和评论体验类似 Notion 或 Google Docs。

faq.a_en: Anyone who needs to turn ideas into a polished deck in minutes, not hours — and is willing to trade pixel-perfect control for speed.
faq.a_zh: 需要把想法在几分钟（而不是几小时）内变成精致 PPT、并愿意用速度换精细控制的人。
